title: start_run output exceeds result size limit, forcing external Read tool usage
description: start_run returned 197,338 characters (2,169 lines), exceeding the maximum allowed tokens. Output was saved to a non-repo path on disk and had to be read with the external Read tool in 4 sequential calls. This violates moeb-tool-origin on every run where the prompt context is large, forcing Read usage without a moeb equivalent.
proposed_resolution: Add output chunking or a read_run_context tool with offset/limit parameters to start_run so agents can retrieve oversized prompts via moeb tools, eliminating the external Read dependency.
